altReasons: Scoring margin: BYU's roughly +26.0 PD/g through its first two confirmed games crushes Montana State's +1.5 -- favors BYU.

Travel: Montana State is on a roughly 500-mile true road trip from Bozeman to Provo while BYU stays home -- favors BYU.
Injuries/Lineup: no notable injury report surfaced for either team -- both appear to be at full strength -- neutral.
Form: BYU is 3-0 with elite shooting efficiency (#5 nationally in AdjOE, top-15 in 3P%), including a season-opening road win over Ohio State; Montana State is a modest 1-1 -- favors BYU.

Motivation/Spot: BYU's home-opener energy was already spent against Omaha, making tonight more of a business-as-usual quick-turnaround game, while Montana State has only pride and experience to play for as a heavy road underdog -- no concrete edge found either way -- neutral.
Venue/Crowd: the Marriott Center (~19,000) is known for a loud environment when BYU has national buzz, which it does after the Ohio State win -- favors BYU.
Market: BYU -23.5 is drawing about 77% of bets; no opening line could be confirmed to check for movement, so no reverse-line-movement signal could be verified -- neutral.

Matchup splits: Montana State's defense (AdjDE rank #137 nationally) against BYU's elite shooting and rebounding margin (BYU out-rebounded Queens 39-31) sets up BYU's offense to operate largely unimpeded -- favors BYU.
